text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the break.
When I visited the Trainer's office for a meeting with Fuji Kiseki—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer...!?
Did I fall asleep, by any chance—
choice_data_list: Slept like a log, of course.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry.
I've shown you an unsightly side of myself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
One of the girls in the dorm was feeling homesick, you see.
I stayed by her side until she fell asleep, but... *yawn*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Fuji Kiseki, the girl in the dorm was able to sleep peacefully,
though it seems Fuji herself didn't get much rest.
